# Structural Checks Reference

25 dependency-aware checks that run after file edits.
These analyze the project graph to detect cross-file issues that single-file lint can't catch.

## Tier 1 — Fast (sub-100ms, every edit)

| Check | Config Key | Description |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| Export Surface | `export_surface` | Detects breaking changes to exported symbols (renamed, removed, type-changed) |
| Import Resolution | `import_resolution` | Validates all imports resolve to real files — catches typos and deleted modules |
| Duplicate Symbols | `duplicate_symbols` | Flags identical export names across files that could cause ambiguous imports |
| Co-Dependency Staleness | `co_dependency_staleness` | Warns when a file's dependencies were recently edited but this file wasn't updated |
| Dead Imports | `dead_imports` | Detects imports that are no longer used after an edit |
| Dead Exports | `dead_exports` | Detects exports with no importers in the project |
| Hallucinated Imports | `hallucinated_imports` | Catches imports of symbols that don't exist in the target module |
| Cross-Package Imports | `cross_package_imports` | Warns on imports that cross monorepo package boundaries incorrectly |
| Undefined Env Vars | `undefined_env_vars` | Flags process.env references not documented in .env.example |
| Sibling Awareness | `sibling_awareness` | Suggests related files that may need updates when editing a module |
| Stale Read Warning | `stale_read_warning` | Warns when reading a file that was modified earlier in the session but not re-read |
| Recently Failed | `recently_failed` | Warns when editing a file that had check failures earlier in the session |
| Redundant Re-read | `redundant_reread` | Detects reading a file that was already read and hasn't changed |
| Route Context | `route_context` | Adds HTTP route/endpoint context when editing handler files |
| Completion Tracking | `completion_tracking` | Tracks pending follow-up edits from export surface changes |

## Tier 2 — Medium (sub-1s, every edit)

| Check | Config Key | Description |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| Import Cycles | `import_cycles` | Detects circular import chains that can cause runtime issues |
| Interface Change Impact | `interface_change_impact` | Identifies files affected when an interface or type definition changes |
| Test Proximity | `test_proximity` | Suggests running related tests when editing source files |
| Blast Radius | `blast_radius` | Estimates how many files are affected by changes to a hub module |
| Layer Violations | `layer_violations` | Enforces architectural layering rules (e.g., UI must not import from DB layer) |
| Test First | `test_first` | Nudge agent to write/run tests before editing source files |
| Cross-File Switch Discriminant | `cross_file_switch_discriminant` | Flags the same switch discriminant (.kind/.type/.tag) appearing in multiple files — usually a polymorphism opportunity |
| Single-Implementation Interface | `single_implementation_interface` | Flags exported interfaces with exactly one implementor — possible premature abstraction |

## Tier 3 — Conditional (1-5s, only when needed)

| Check | Config Key | Description |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| Smart TypeScript Check | `smart_tsc` | Runs tsc only on the edited file when export surface didn't change (avoids full project rebuild) |
| Impact Analysis | `impact_analysis` | Full dependency graph analysis showing breaking changes and affected downstream files |
